AuditTrace.description:
Deterministic audit trail attached to every calculation result.

The trace is one component of the CalculationHashEnvelope.
The calculation hash also covers the schema version, relevant input
fields, MethodPolicy and calculated results — not the trace alone.

disambiguation_required.description: True iff an ambiguous Y (ADR 0001) or other ambiguity was hit.
disambiguation_required.title: Disambiguation Required

AuditTrace.title: AuditTrace

CalculationStep.description:
A single auditable step in a calculation (Master Contract §6.3).

The deterministic hash of a result is computed over the sorted JSON of
its steps, so every step must carry exactly the fields that influence
the outcome - nothing more, nothing less.

inputs.description: Numeric inputs consumed by this step, in order.
inputs.title: Inputs

note.description: Optional deterministic note (no free text logic).
note.title: Note

output.description: Numeric output produced by this step.
output.title: Output

CalculationStep.title: CalculationStep

ClaimType.description:
Statement classes (Master Contract §2.2).

Every artifact in the system is tagged with exactly one claim type so
that symbolic tradition, deterministic calculation, interpretive
hypothesis and empirical evidence can never be silently conflated.
ClaimType.title: ClaimType

CycleCalculationResult.description: Personal date cycles and the four lifetime Pinnacle/Challenge phases.
CycleCalculationResult.title: CycleCalculationResult

CyclePhase.description: One numbered Pinnacle or Challenge phase with inclusive age boundaries.
CyclePhase.title: CyclePhase

DateMethod.description:
Life Path reduction strategy.

``BOTH`` runs A and B and emits a consistency warning when they
diverge (Master Contract §3.2, V1 minimal scope).
DateMethod.title: DateMethod

KarmicDebtInfo.description:
Methodically defined karmic debt number with its origin (Korrektur 1).

The marker is attached ONLY when the *unreduced core value* of a Life
Path method (the raw total before the first reduction step) is one of
{13, 14, 16, 19}. Random intermediate sums are NOT karmic markers.
``origin`` records which methodical component produced the value, e.g.
``'total_sum'`` (Life Path A) or ``'component_sum'`` (Life Path B).

origin.description: Methodical component that produced the value (e.g. 'total_sum').
origin.title: Origin

KarmicDebtInfo.title: KarmicDebtInfo

LegacyV2NameNumberSet.description: Historical V2 name contract, accepted only for server-side recalculation.
LegacyV2NameNumberSet.title: LegacyV2NameNumberSet

LegacyV2ProfileCalculationResult.description: Read-only V2 envelope; calculated fields are never trusted by the API.
LegacyV2ProfileCalculationResult.title: LegacyV2ProfileCalculationResult

LifePathResult.description:
Life Path result for one reduction method (A or B).

Carries the *methodically defined unreduced core value* (``raw_total``)
alongside the final reduced value, the slash-notation reduction path
(``compound_notation``) and an optional karmic-debt marker attached to
that raw total (Korrektur 1).

compound_notation.description: Reduction path as slash-notation, e.g. '19/10/1' or '37/10/1'.
compound_notation.title: Compound Notation

karmic_debt.description: Karmic debt info iff raw_total is a karmic debt number, else None.

raw_total.description: Methodically defined unreduced core value before the first reduction.
raw_total.title: Raw Total

reduced_value.description: Final reduced value (1-9 or a master number); mirrors reduction.value.
reduced_value.title: Reduced Value

steps.description: Ordered audit steps for this method.
steps.title: Steps

LifePathResult.title: LifePathResult

Locale.description:
Locale for normalization policy selection.

V1 ships only ``DE``; other locales are extension points.
Locale.title: Locale

MethodPolicy.description:
Explicit method configuration (Master Contract §6.2).

No silent defaults: every policy dimension relevant to 0.1.0 is an
explicit field with a documented canonical default. Mixing
incompatible policies (e.g. two umlaut policies) is rejected.
MethodPolicy.title: MethodPolicy

MethodSystem.description:
Numerological method systems.

V1 implements only ``PYTHAGOREAN``. Other systems are documented
extension points (Master Contract §3.1) and must never be silently
mixed (calculation-engineer agent contract §4).
MethodSystem.title: MethodSystem

NameBasis.description:
Two-level name model selector (ADR 0004).

There is intentionally no ``MIXED`` or ``WEIGHTED`` value: silently
fusing ``core_name`` and ``active_name`` would violate the statement
class separation (Master Contract §2.2).
NameBasis.title: NameBasis

NameNumberSet.description: All name-derived values for one explicitly separated name profile.
NameNumberSet.title: NameNumberSet

NameNumberVariant.description: A complete vowel/consonant result for one explicit Y interpretation.
NameNumberVariant.title: NameNumberVariant

NameSegmentResult.description: Auditable subtotal for one whitespace- or hyphen-delimited name segment.
NameSegmentResult.title: NameSegmentResult

NumberResult.description: One deterministic numerological value with a reproducible reduction path.
NumberResult.title: NumberResult

PersonInput.description:
Person input contract (Master Contract §6.1).

The Walking Skeleton (0.1.0) only consumes ``core_name`` and
``birth_date`` for the Life Path calculation, but the full contract is
modelled here so later name-based numbers (Expression, Soul Urge,
Personality, Maturity - Phase 4+) can reuse the same input without a
breaking migration.

* ``core_name`` - full birth name (authoritative for the core profile,
  ADR 0004 §1). Required.
* ``active_name`` - currently used name, optional. When present and
  different from ``core_name`` it triggers the supplementary profile
  (ADR 0004 §2). Never silently merged with ``core_name``.
* ``birth_date`` - calendar date of birth. The Life Path A/B
  calculations operate exclusively on this field.
* ``as_of_date`` - explicit evaluation date for deterministic tests.
  MUST be >= ``birth_date`` for a person profile (Korrektur 3); the
  domain core never calls ``date.today()`` - the CLI defaults this at
  its own boundary (Korrektur 2). General date analysis (later) will
  not carry this constraint.

active_name.description: Currently used name; optional supplementary profile basis.
active_name.title: Active Name

as_of_date.description: Explicit evaluation date for deterministic tests. birth_date must be <= as_of_date for a person profile.
as_of_date.title: As Of Date

consent_given.description: Whether the data subject consented to processing.
consent_given.title: Consent Given

PersonInput.title: PersonInput

ProblemDetails.description: RFC-9457-style API error with a stable machine-readable code.
ProblemDetails.title: ProblemDetails

ProfileCalculationRequest.description: Explicit person and method policy submitted to the deterministic core.
ProfileCalculationRequest.title: ProfileCalculationRequest

ProfileCalculationResult.description: Complete deterministic profile contract introduced for release 0.1.4.
ProfileCalculationResult.title: ProfileCalculationResult

ReductionOutcome.description:
A reduced numeric result with master-number metadata.

``value`` is always in ``1..9`` or one of the configured master numbers.
``intermediate`` is the pre-reduction sum (useful for the audit trace).

Karmic-debt detection moved OFF this primitive (Korrektur 1): the marker
is only meaningful on the *methodically defined unreduced core value*
of a Life Path method, not on arbitrary intermediate sums. The karmic
info therefore lives on :class:`LifePathResult` (``karmic_debt``), not
here. This primitive stays focused on numeric reduction + master-flag.

is_master.description: True iff value is a master number.
is_master.title: Is Master

value.description: Reduced value (1..9 or a master number).
value.title: Value

ReductionOutcome.title: ReductionOutcome

UmlautPolicy.description:
German umlaut / semantic normalization policy (ADR 0002).

``DE_DIRECT_V1`` is the V1 default for ``locale=de``. The two policies
must never be mixed within a single calculation (ADR 0002 §7).
UmlautPolicy.title: UmlautPolicy

YMode.description:
Y classification policy (ADR 0001).

``PHONETIC`` is the V1 canonical default for ``pythagorean-v1``.
YMode.title: YMode
